verdict.rationale: Rippling documents workflow automation (custom workflows for notifications/admin tasks, cross-app workflow triggers, and flexible payroll run scheduling) but there is no explicit documentation of a recurring-job scheduler, cron-like API, or AI-native automation interface for setting up repeating workflows programmatically. missing for 10: explicit recurring/cron scheduling API, developer-facing docs on scheduling workflows, AI-agent-triggered recurring automation, independent confirmation of this capability.
